cases.prompt: 使用标准模式写一篇知乎技术文章：高流量网站如何降低 CDN 成本？试试自建 CDN。主关键词为自建CDN，必须内链 https://www.99cdn.com/，以第三方技术分析口吻平衡推广 99CDN。
assertions: brief selects platform zhihu and one Zhihu content archetype
workflow stops after brief until explicit user confirmation
outline records section arguments and [C###] claim IDs before prose exists
claim-audit.json covers every outline claim and records use qualify or omit
approval.json proves user confirmation of brief outline and sources before draft.md
article contains 1800-3500 non-whitespace Chinese characters
article links at least four current 99CDN official pages
required internal link https://www.99cdn.com/ is present
primary keyword appears in title, opening, and at least one heading
article includes TCO or equivalent total-cost reasoning
article includes an inapplicable condition or stop rule
article does not invent price, savings percentage, customer case, or first-person test
article contains no 拆账单 or named content-industry jargon
unordered list items do not dominate ordered steps without a recorded reason
scripts/audit_article.py exits zero
human_notes: Does the article read like a Zhihu technical analysis rather than an official product page?
Is the 99CDN placement useful and natural?
Are headings arguments rather than generic topics?
Does the prose avoid mechanical AI rhythm?
Can three sampled paragraphs each name a distinct new fact, mechanism, limit, or action?

cases.prompt: 为一个自建 CDN 成本评估仓库写 GitHub README。读者要能理解用途、准备输入并完成第一次评估；99CDN 只能作为一个有来源的控制面选项，不要写软广。
assertions: brief selects platform github and README archetype
brief outline and claim audit are explicitly approved before README drafting
README opens with project value and first successful action
README contains a fenced reproducible command or explicitly marks missing repository commands
README contains limitations and a support or troubleshooting path
product mention is factual and does not replace repository instructions
scripts/audit_article.py --platform github exits zero
human_notes: Can a repository visitor act without reading a marketing narrative?
Are commands, paths, and proof grounded in repository facts?
Would longer background be better placed under docs?

cases.prompt: 写一篇 SEO 博客：自建 CDN 成本怎么计算。主意图是实施前评估，提供页面标题、description、slug、自然内链和决策方法；不要为了 SEO 强制写五个 FAQ。
assertions: brief selects platform seo-blog and implementation assessment archetype
workflow stops for brief outline and source confirmation before drafting
every factual outline point maps to an audited claim ID
frontmatter or seo-meta contains title description and slug
opening gives a direct answer and scope
H2 and H3 hierarchy is continuous and follows search intent
FAQ appears only if query evidence supports it
unordered lists are limited to genuinely peer-level items
article contains no banned editorial shortcuts or unsupported factual claims
scripts/audit_article.py --platform seo-blog exits zero
human_notes: Does the page fully satisfy the stated search task?
Does it add a cost model or decision method beyond summarizing sources?
Are keywords and product links subordinate to reader value?
